parsed.note_claim: The claim of 62 million visits misattributes traffic from Motherless.com, a porn site with related content, to the group itself.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The website, which had around 62 million visits in February alone and whose core audience is in the United States, describes itself as a "moral free file host where anything legal is hosted forever."
parsed.reason: The article explicitly attributes the 62 million visits figure to Motherless.com, confirming the note's correction that this traffic statistic does not apply to the Telegram group.
